definitions.explanation: A car classified as a standard passenger vehicle, as opposed to a light car ({軽自動車|けいじどうしゃ}). Used in contexts like car rental, parking fees, and vehicle registration.
An ordinary, unreserved car on a train, as opposed to a reserved car ({指定席車|していせきしゃ}) or Green Car (グリーン{車|しゃ}). The most basic class of seating on Japanese trains.

notes:
Has two main meanings depending on context: a standard passenger car (as opposed to a light car) and a regular-class train car.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {普通車|ふつうしゃ}⟦{自由席|じゆうせき}→自由席：07047_jiyuuseki⟧: non-reserved regular seat
- {普通車|ふつうしゃ}⟦{指定席|していせき}→指定席：07046_shiteiseki⟧: reserved regular seat
- {普通車|ふつうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{免許|めんきょ}→免許：03808_menkyo⟧: standard car license

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{軽自動車|けいじどうしゃ}→軽自動車：14298_keijidousha⟧: light car — smaller engine displacement, lower taxes
- ⟦グリーン{車|しゃ}→グリーン車：08489_guriinsha⟧: Green Car — first-class train car with wider seats
- ⟦{乗用車|じょうようしゃ}→乗用車：11411_jouyousha⟧: passenger car — broader term for any car used for passengers
